overview_title: What Is the Best Belize Itinerary for the Rainforest and the Reef?
answer: Deep Belize is James Wild & Co's ten-day answer: four nights at Blancaneaux Lodge in the Mountain Pine Ridge for waterfalls, horses, caves and the Maya cities, then five at Thatch Caye Resort, an all-inclusive private island for 30 guests nine miles off Dangriga, with the barrier reef fifteen minutes away by boat. Fly into Belize City (BZE): Blancaneaux books charter flights, helicopters or the road, and Thatch Caye is a short flight to Dangriga and a boat.

days.title: Belize City to the Mountain Pine Ridge
days.line: By charter, helicopter or road from BZE
days.body: From Belize City (BZE), Blancaneaux pre-books private charter flights, helicopters or land transfers; by road the drive takes about 2 to 2.5 hours. The lodge's thatched cabañas and villas sit above Privassion Creek in the 107,000-acre Mountain Pine Ridge Forest Reserve.

days.title: Creeks and the Rio On Pools
days.body: Creek swimming holes and the Rio On Pools, then horseback riding in the Mountain Pine Ridge, where pine forest meets jungle and the region's waterfalls.

days.title: Caracol, Xunantunich or the caves
days.line: The Maya world of western Belize
days.body: The Maya cities of Caracol or Xunantunich, or the caves: ATM, Crystal and Barton Creek, where you canoe through.

days.title: The Waterfall Spa
days.body: A slower day: the Waterfall Spa, the creek and the forest around the lodge.

days.title: The Pine Ridge to the cayes
days.line: By air to Dangriga, then by boat
days.body: Back to Belize City by charter, helicopter or road, then a commuter flight of about 15 minutes (or a van) to Dangriga, and Thatch Caye's included 35-minute boat from Pelican Beach Resort, which leaves daily at 2:30pm and 4:30pm.
days.move: Air, then boat · about 15 min flight, 35 min boat

days.title: The barrier reef
days.line: Fifteen minutes by boat from the island
days.body: The barrier reef is a 15-minute boat ride away, with an on-site PADI dive shop, and you can snorkel straight from shore.

days.title: Kayaks and paddleboards
days.line: Thatch Caye, nine miles off Dangriga
days.body: Non-motorized water sports are included: kayaks and paddleboards off the island.

days.title: Thirty guests, one table
days.line: Thatch Caye, nine miles off Dangriga
days.body: The island takes only 30 guests at a time, with one member of staff to each guest, and dinner is communal and farm to table.

days.title: Unplugged
days.line: Thatch Caye, nine miles off Dangriga
days.body: A free day on the island: the reef, the water or the hammock on your patio.

days.title: Home through Belize City

days.body: The boat back to Dangriga and the commuter flight of about 15 minutes to Belize City (BZE) for flights home.

getThere.title: Charter, Helicopter, Then the Boat
getThere.intro: Everything starts at Belize City (BZE). Flights and helicopters come first wherever a lodge offers them; road times only as each lodge states them.
points: By charter or helicopter to Blancaneaux
From BZE, Blancaneaux pre-books private charter flights, helicopters or land transfers. By road the drive takes about 2 to 2.5 hours.
By air and boat to Thatch Caye
A commuter flight of about 15 minutes, or a van, from BZE to Dangriga, then the included 35-minute boat from Pelican Beach Resort, daily at 2:30pm and 4:30pm.
Inland instead: Hidden Valley by helicopter
Hidden Valley Lodge is roughly 20 minutes by helicopter from Belize City, over 1,000 Foot Falls, or about 2.5 hours by road from BZE.
On the coast instead: Turtle Inn
Fly about 35 minutes from BZE to the Placencia airstrip (PLJ), five minutes from Turtle Inn; private charter and helicopter arrivals can be arranged, or drive about 3 to 3.5 hours.

founder.title: A Few Nights Inland, Then the Caribbean
founder.p1: James Papagno has been designing Belize journeys since 1992. He has not stayed at Blancaneaux Lodge or Thatch Caye Resort; both are filed from the properties' own information.
founder.p2: Belize rewards travellers who do more than one thing well, so the route does two: four nights in the Mountain Pine Ridge for the waterfalls, caves and Maya cities, then five on a private island on the second-largest barrier reef on earth.

faqs: What is the best Belize itinerary for the rainforest and the reef?

Ten days and nine nights: four at Blancaneaux Lodge in the Mountain Pine Ridge, then five at Thatch Caye Resort, an all-inclusive private island nine miles off Dangriga. Fly in and out of Belize City (BZE).
How do you get to Blancaneaux Lodge?
From Belize City (BZE), the lodge pre-books private charter flights, helicopters or land transfers. By road the drive takes about 2 to 2.5 hours.
How do you get to Thatch Caye?
A commuter flight of about 15 minutes, or a van, from BZE to Dangriga, then the resort's included 35-minute boat from Pelican Beach Resort, daily at 2:30pm and 4:30pm.
When is the best time to go?

December to May. Blancaneaux names November through May as the drier season inland; in the green season rain is heavier and the waterfalls may be fuller. Thatch Caye names December to May as the drier season on the reef.
Yes: meals, drinks and non-motorized water sports are included, for only 30 guests at a time, with an on-site PADI dive shop.
Which other lodges can we choose?

Inland, Hidden Valley Lodge, The Lodge at Chaa Creek, Ka'ana Resort or The Rainforest Lodge at Sleeping Giant. On the coast, Turtle Inn at Placencia, Matachica on Ambergris Caye or Coco Plum Island Resort off Dangriga. Each has its own page in the Ledger.

Yes. Guatemala is next door: Bolontiku on Lake Petén Itzá can meet guests coming from Belize at the Melchor de Mencos border, about 1 hour 35 minutes from its dock. Guatemala in 7 Days is the house's Guatemala route.
Has James stayed at these lodges?
No. James has designed Belize journeys since 1992, but he has not stayed at Blancaneaux Lodge or Thatch Caye Resort; both are filed from the properties' own information.
How much does Deep Belize cost?
It is quoted against your dates and travellers. James Wild & Co does not publish a fixed price for this route.
